description: A propositional theory \(\Gamma\) is unsatisfiable if and only if some finite subset of \(\Gamma\) is unsatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.finite_unsatisfiable_obstruction.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheorySatisfiable Γ ↔
    ∃ Δ, ↑Δ ⊆ Γ ∧ ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Satisfiable Δ
